as_told.title: LiDAR over the Amazon reveals geoglyphs

plain: A writer on lost ancient civilisations, Graham Hancock, says that lidar, a laser scan from the air that can see the ground through treetops, is turning up big surprises in the Amazon rainforest, as shown in the second season of his TV series Ancient Apocalypse. He says the Amazon was once home to tens of millions of people who fed themselves, with huge permanent cities and vast, very precise geometric earthworks that can only be seen whole from above. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, later repeated a shorter version, mentioning only the shapes popping out of the scans, and it matters because it would mean the jungle once held a great civilisation.
